note: The screen captures the video uses, in sets: each set is one screen rectangle at one Windows scale, so the video swaps its pictures in place and only the drawn layers move (docs/research/promo-video.md, 'Real captures and drawn parts'). Real captures of p6-media-captures (2026-11-05, the installed local 0.1.0 build of commit c9da3dd, the DELL U2723QE at 200%, dark taskbar, cursor never in the picture, TrafficMonitor and the clock covered with plain taskbar), from its captures.json. w and h are the rectangle in capture pixels; boxes and rows are places inside it in the same pixels (the cursor, the ring and the pops land on them); a box ending in Pop is a part grown by its shadow, for the part that rises in. 'battery' is the menu set's battery figure: 96% in S1 and 97% in S5a to S5d (it was charging), so the video always shows S5a's. stills are the README's pictures, not used in the video.
